Pep/8 Lab — browser implementation and learning IDE.
Copyright (C) 2026  최규하 (Choi Gyuha), Soongsil University, Global School of Media

This is a modified work based on Pep/8 by J. Stanley Warford and contributors,
https://github.com/StanWarford/pep8
Copyright (C) 2009  J. Stanley Warford, Pepperdine University

Modifications (November 2026):
- engine.js and session.js are JavaScript ports of the upstream C++ sources
  (asm.cpp, code.cpp, sim.cpp, pep.cpp, cpupane.cpp, mainwindow.cpp,
  objectcodepane.cpp, assemblerlistingpane.cpp), adapted to run in a browser.
- Web-only limits were added: runs pause every 1,000,000 instructions and
  output stops at 200,000 characters.
- vendor/pep8os.pep is the Pep/8 Operating System (2004/08/30), included unmodified.
- The user interface (index.html, app.js, layout.js, editor.js, examples.js,
  style.css, layout.css) is new code written for this project.

All application source and the OS source are served unminified.
Official project: https://computersystemsbook.com/4th-edition/pep8/
This is not an official Pep/8 release.
